tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// 'jam dpal la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ skyabs mchog sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// dpal ldan bla ma la btud de// sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yab// 'jam pa'i dpal la bstod par bgyi// ming la brten nas don tshol ba// 'di ni shes ldan rnams kyi lugs// thub pas khyod mtshan 'jam dpal zhes// bsgrags don de ni 'di ltar khums// sems kyi rang bzhin spros pa yi// grwa zur zhi bas 'jam pa nyid// rten 'byung srid zhi'i dpal gyi gzhi// 'di 'dra rgyu yi 'jam dpal lags// stong nyid rtogs pas lta ba yi// tshang tshing zhi bas 'jam pa nyid// snying rjes skye 'gro'i dpal gyur pa// 'di 'dra lam gyi 'jam dpal lags// sku gsum mi phyed mnyam sbyor zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// yon tan phrin las mthar phyin pa// 'di 'dra 'bras bu'i 'jam dpal lags// chos dbyings rang bzhin 'jam pa'i ngang*// gzugs kyi sku ni gdul bya'i dpal// sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa po// 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// kun nas mdzes pa 'jam pa'i sku// mtshan dang dpe byad nyer 'bar ba// gang gis mthong ba'i dpal gyur pa// 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// theg mchog ston pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs// yan lag drug cus zug rngu sel// gang gis thos pas dpal gyur pa// 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib gnyis dri bral 'jam pa'i thugs// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// gang gis dran pa'i dpal gyur pa// 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// srid zhi mnyam nyid 'jam pa ste// stobs dang mi 'jigs rig pa sogs// gang gis rjes su slob pa'i dpal// 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro la mnyam dgongs 'jam pa nyid// rnam 'phrul du mas rnam kun tu// gang gis dad pa'i dpal gyur pa// 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar rgyu dang lam dang ni// 'bras bu'i chos rnam gang lags pa// de kun 'jam pa'i dpal nyid de// rnam par spros na mtha' yas lags// de slad dus gsum rgyal ba kun// 'jam dpal gyis bskyed ces pa dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam dpal zhes// gsungs pa'ang nges pa'i don du 'tshal// rgyal ba ming dang mtshan ma yi// tshul du gang btags de yis ni// de bzhin gshegs pa ma mthong la// gang gis tshul 'dis sangs rgyas kun// 'jam dpal nyid du legs rtogs pa// de yis rgyal ba'i nges pa'i sku// gdon mi za bar 'tshal ba lags// de slad gaṅgā'i rdul snyed kyi// thung mtshan bskal par brjod pa bas// 'jam dpal zhes brjod khyad 'phags zhes// gang gsungs de yang nges par khums// rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs bral dang*// tshangs spyod chos kun gnas med dang*// gzhan gyi don la rtse dga'i phyir// gzhon nur gyur pa khyod phyag 'tshal// bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa kun// ma rig pa las byung ba ste// khyod kyis de yang dbyings 'byin pas// gshin rje'i dgrar gyur khyod phyag 'tshal// sku yi mtshan dang rnam pa dang*// kha dog dang ni phyag mtshan dang*// cha lugs gsung gis gsang sngags kun// gdul bya'i rgyud la zab mo'i don// mtshon pa'i phyir dang thob bya'i phyir// sgyu ma'i tshul gyis rnam sprul pa// 'di 'dra rgyal ba thabs mkhas pa// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam 'khrul lags// de slad de la rnam kun tu// spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// bsam pa thag pas skyabs su mchi// rtag tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol// khyod kyi rang bzhin ji bzhin dang*// rnam 'phrul mdzad pa ji snyed pa// 'phags mchog rnams kyi'ang yul min na// bdag 'dras ji ltar rtogs par 'gyur// 'on kyang bsam mi khyab pa dang*// mtshungs med dpe med zla med cing*// dpag yas nyid du legs khums pas// de lta'i tshul gyis bsngags pa lags// khyod kyi mtshan las khyod yon tan// brtags nas tshig gi phreng bas bstod// don dang mi ldan rjes bsngags pa// sgro 'dogs yin phyir smad pa'i gnas// rgya mtsho las ni byung ba'i chus// rgya mtsho'i lha ni mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba'i gsung las 'byung ba yi// tshul gyis khyod la bsngags pa lags// 'di la sdeb sbyor ma mchis shing*// gal te don yang 'gal gyur na// brtse bas bzod par dgongs nas kyang*// 'khrul pa'i drwa ba dral du gsol// dad pas brjod slad dge bsags pa// gang yin de yis 'gro ba kun// blo mchog 'jam mgon rjes zhugs nas// 'jam pa'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog

/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas/ me mo sbrul gyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu bdun la ri bo rtse lngar sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
